programs.title: Kudrat
programs.desc: Chandramukhi visits Shimla and learns that she is a reincarnation of Paro, a girl who was raped and murdered. Plagued by her dark past, she attempts to bring the culprits to justice.

programs.title: Gumrah
programs.desc: Meena, who lives with her retired and widowed father in rural Nainital, is visited by her sister, her husband and her two children. Meena speaks of her love for Rajendra, a painter and singer, and Kamla, her sister, approves of her choice. However, before Meena can make a move, Kamla passes away leaving her children in the hands of Meena.

programs.title: Anhonee (1973)
programs.desc: Dr Rekha admits a patient, Sunil, in her mental hospital. He responds to the treatment and recovers. They love each other but Sunil is not what he claims to be and Rekha too has a dark secret.
